utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Faye, I heard the repair drive is this Saturday. What's the plan? I want to double-check the details before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's Saturday from 10 AM at the community center. We're fixing up old bikes and small appliances—I could really use your help with sorting parts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, Saturday from 10 AM at the community center—got it. And for the sorting, do we have a list of what parts we're expecting, or are we just figuring it out on the spot?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? It's from 10 to 4—great chance to get things fixed and lend a hand!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh hey Sam, yeah I heard a bit about it—Hana was just checking with me about the tool list. What time are you heading over?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I was thinking of getting there around 9:30 to help set up, want to meet up and walk over together?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: This is really coming together! Who's helping with transport?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Andersons are bringing their truck. That should be enough.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the Andersons? They're always so reliable. Did you hear they just got a new roof too?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, but Vik mentioned his truck and bins—do we know if that'll be enough to haul everything we need?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm not sure about the truck's capacity. Maybe we should check with Vik?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly, let's get a firm count on how many bins we'll actually need before Saturday—I'd hate for us to be scrambling last minute.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—wait, are we fixing bikes or something else? I keep losing track.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Noah, this Saturday we're fixing up small appliances and lawn gear—Sam's even bringing his old lawnmower! Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, lawn gear, right! I'll see if I can dig up that broken leaf blower. Count me in!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Nell, I've got my pickup ready for Saturday—just let me know what time you need me at the playground.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Saturday, that's what I thought! I've got my old lamp ready to go. What time should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's meet at 8 AM sharp—I like to get an early start and we'll have plenty of time to organize everything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Mina, just so you know, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday, huh? What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It starts at 10 a.m., so you've got the morning to sleep in if you want!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely, Quinn! I’d love to help. What kind of items are we focusing on, and where’s the drop-off point?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about this repair drive thing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm serious! Quinn already set up the drop-off at the community center parking lot, starting at 9 AM Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rosa! I'm so glad I caught you—I'm organizing a neighborhood repair drive this Saturday and we could really use your help spreading the word!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Quinn, that's wonderful you're thinking of that! But actually, we had to move it to Sunday at the community center—can you help me update the word around?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Sunday at the community center—got it! I'll make sure everyone knows about the change.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's this Saturday, Nell! I've already got my wrenches and screwdrivers lined up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: This Saturday! Got it. I think I have a hammer somewhere... maybe I should start looking for it now so I don't forget by then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Oren—if you can't find yours, I've got a spare hammer you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, I did hear something about that. Sunday works better for me anyway.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I'm glad you can make it. I've got some spare parts in my garage if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You know, I just told Mara and Sam about the repair drive this Saturday—community center, 10 to 4, bring anything broken!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Vik, the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I'll be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I must have missed that memo! So it's Sunday from 10 to 4 then? I'll make sure to tell Noah too—he asked me about it earlier.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks Gus! I'll make sure to be there too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, Nell! Let me know if you need any tools from my shed for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus! I might take you up on that—I don't have much in the way of tools myself.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Oren, just wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday? Oh, right, that's the new date. Thanks for letting me know, Rosa! I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'm so glad you can still join us! See you Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Quinn, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? It's at the community center from 10 to 4—bring anything broken and we'll fix it together!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, I'm actually the one organizing it! Can't wait to see everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, you're organizing it? That's awesome! So it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4—bring anything broken and we'll fix it together!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the community center! Right, right. I think I did hear someone mention that... sorry, my head's been all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the plan for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Plan? Uh, I thought we were just showing up and seeing what needs doing. Am I supposed to bring something?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Sam, just a heads up—the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. Your lawnmower still coming?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Mara! Yeah, the lawnmower's still ready to go — I'll bring it Sunday for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll pencil you in. And don't forget to bring that extra pair of hands—we might need help hauling things!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Opal, just checking—are you still free to help with the repair drive this weekend? I'm trying to sort out the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm still free! I've got the list of spots we're fixing—Quinn's mapped it all out, so just let me know what time works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Opal! How does 10 AM on Saturday sound? I can do the morning pickup shift before that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center? I've got spare parts if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, thanks Cleo. I hadn't heard about the change—good to know. Spare parts would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I'll make sure to bring them over Sunday morning. Let me know if you need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great that we have volunteers and bins, but do we have enough people to sort through everything?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, I'm not sure—maybe check with Gus or Tess? I think they're handling that part.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, but if Gus and Tess aren't confirmed yet, we might be in trouble. Have you actually heard back from them?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I'm late. Did the repair drive get moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! Actually, it's still on Saturday, but Sam's bringing his lawnmower and I'm swapping pick-up duties with Hana—should be a good one!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Wait, really? I thought I heard it was moved to Sunday. My bad—glad we're all on the same page now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check what tools we have first, and I'll get back to you, Sam.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, keep me posted.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do, Leo. Also, can you confirm if you're available to lend a hand on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that? I thought it might've been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Wait, Sunday at the community center? I thought it was still Saturday on our block. Who told you that?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I saw the updated flyer myself. You really didn't hear about the change?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there Sunday, but I'm afraid I'm not in the best shape to lift much.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh no worries, Uli! Bo's gonna bring his truck, so we can use the lift on that for heavy stuff.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's a relief, Tess. I can still sort and organize things, just can't do the heavy lifting.
